name: Simple Rune
summary: At Anvilmar, Sten Stoutarm brings new dwarven warriors a summons from Thran Khorman. The rune calls them from Coldridge Valley's snowy paths to begin training.

sections.title: A Summons to the Anvil
sections.body: Veteran scouts watch recruits clear pests around Coldridge Valley, seeking promising fighters. Sten brings an inscribed stone from Thran Khorman. Its simple rune calls them from the snowy paths into Anvilmar's warm forge-hall, where they can pledge themselves to the warrior's trade.

sections.title: A Changing Dun Morogh
sections.body: Thran speaks plainly about Dun Morogh's troubles. Gnomes displaced by the explosions that destroyed Gnomeregan seek refuge, while some dwarves take up foreign arcane arts or follow the human faith in the Holy Light. Troggs claw at the mountain borders after being disturbed deep underground. Thran believes firm martial discipline is needed to withstand these threats.

faq.answer: Sten Stoutarm carries an inscribed slate on Thran Khorman's behalf. It invites new warriors to report indoors for training.
Thran Khorman trains warriors inside Anvilmar in Coldridge Valley. He teaches young dwarven and gnomish warriors melee combat, discipline, and dwarven tenacity.

faq.q: Why are gnomes living in Dun Morogh and Ironforge?
faq.answer: Gnomes fled Gnomeregan after setting off catastrophic radiation explosives in a desperate attempt to repel a trogg invasion. The survivors sought refuge with their dwarven allies in Ironforge.

Troggs are primitive, vicious creatures disturbed deep underground. They have recently breached the surface caves in Coldridge Valley and Dun Morogh, threatening settlements and trade routes. Anvilmar's defenders must stay armed and watchful.

faq.q: What does Thran mean about dwarves worshipping the Holy Light?
faq.answer: Some dwarves took up the Holy Light through close ties with human kingdoms such as Lordaeron and Stormwind. They now train their own paladins and priests.

faq.q: Where do I take the Simple Rune?
aliases: where to turn in simple rune
faq.answer: Take the rune to Thran Khorman at the training grounds inside Anvilmar's great bunker hall, just up the path in Coldridge Valley.

angles.text: As a warrior, the rune marks your formal entrance into martial discipline and sends you to Thran Khorman in Anvilmar.
As a dwarf, you can learn traditional grit from Thran Khorman. He teaches recruits to hold fast to their culture of steel and iron as the world changes.
As a gnome driven from Gnomeregan by troggs and radiation, you learn frontline warfare alongside dwarven mentors in Coldridge Valley to survive exile.
As an Alliance member, you train in Coldridge Valley, where mountain forces defend the southern approaches to Khaz Modan.
